_note: Every ABA-approved law school in the 50 states plus DC (193 of them). Each category comes from one vetted source. Admissions (applications, offers, acceptance rate, enrollment, 25/50/75 GPA and LSAT), tuition, employment outcomes and first-time bar passage are the ABA's own Standard 509 compilation reports (abarequireddisclosures.org); `_vintage` says which class or year each describes. 30 schools charge per credit; their tuition is annualized at a third of the JD's required credit hours, as reported to the ABA, so it's approximate. `rank` is the U.S. News rank, null where U.S. News publishes none, and `tier` is derived from it. Write-ups marked `writeupAuto` are generated from these figures by tools/writeups.py; the rest are hand-written. `formerNames` lists a renamed school's old names so saved lists follow it. Refresh with tools/fetch_aba.py. Editable.
